summary: Frontend-only e2e test of cosmic portfolio. All 6 sections render correctly. Hero headlines, CTAs (incl. CV /cv.pdf link and scroll-to-projects), About chips (10/10) draggable, Projects (4 cards + black hole), Skills (5 clusters, 21 stars, tooltip on hover), Awards (front + back newspaper headlines after flip), Contact whale -> form -> success ('Message received across the cosmos') -> back-to-whale, and footer links all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form is intentionally mocked (frontend setTimeout) — no API, as per problem statement (acceptable).
Hero CV button uses Tag='a' but onClick is bound; harmless. /cv.pdf is a placeholder per spec.
Auto-reset of contact form after 4s could surprise users; consider keeping success until user dismisses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sections verified in one render. Drag of about-chip-0 confirmed (position changes). Newspaper flip animation reveals back headline after ~1.5s. Contact success appears after ~1s of submit; auto-resets in 4s. Footer links: mailto, github, linkedin all correct.
